title: ConsentGrant
description: Explicit, auditable permission for one lead.submit payload and its selected contact channels. A missing grant returns CONTACT_CONSENT_REQUIRED. A malformed, expired or inapplicable grant returns INVALID_CONSENT. A session, tool selection or OAuth authorization is not customer contact consent.

granted_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp at which the user authorized this share (e.g. '2026-04-30T11:05:00Z'). MUST include a timezone offset (Z or ±HH:MM).

allowed_channels.description: Channels the user has authorized the dealer to use for follow-up.

consent_text.description: Verbatim text the user agreed to (e.g. the disclosure shown by the buyer agent). MUST be non-empty — this is the audit trail of what the user actually saw.

scope.description: Scope of the consent. AAP defines a single value `lead_submission` covering the unified `lead.submit` skill (which spans general inquiries, vehicle interest, trade-in, and appointments). The request body itself shows what was actually submitted; the meaningful audit granularity is `allowed_channels`.

expires_at.description: Optional deadline for using this grant. When present it must follow granted_at. The dealer must not deliver or use customer contact data after this time without renewed permission. AAP does not prescribe a legal consent lifetime.
